## Scope

Describe one bounded change and the LG V60/ROM/vendor baseline tested.

## Verification

- [ ] Portable tests pass.
- [ ] `python tools/audit_public_release.py` passes.
- [ ] `python tools/generate_release_manifest.py` was rerun.
- [ ] Proven/observed/inferred status is explicit.
- [ ] No APK, firmware, partition, QCN/EFS, DRM/persist, serial, IMEI, private log or user media is included.
- [ ] Upstream/community credit is preserved.
